notes.title: Linux Release and Permanent Price Drop
notes.notes:
Hello,

We've finally managed to get the Linux port ready, hadn't really planned on this port but I thought I'd give it a shot, and was fairly not too difficult to manage.

We don't use Linux for our daily work, so, if you run into issues please do write  back, will try our best to fix it.

And if you've noticed we've introduced a permanent price drop, bringing the price to $6.99. After analysing our sales over the past year, we felt this was a more suited price point.

Do check out the revamped trailer and artwork, we felt this to be more in line with the hard-core nature of the game.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27758100/c87387d71e77556454d083d72e7f6b93a9993cec.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27758100/6f03c9592d1bbd7e524ae7eb2b033126f581a9fd.png[/img][/url]

And that's it for this announcement.
Thank you.

notes.title: Free Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, 

You can now try the Free Demo of 'Switch - Or Die Trying'.

Please share this with your friends.

If you enjoyed the Demo 
[h1]Please! consider purchasing the Full Version[/h1]
Every Paid Purchase Counts.
[b]And do leave a Review.[/b]

This Demo was made during [b]Greenlight[/b] and has a few caveats:
-Contains limited levels (full game has 75 levels, demo only 12)
-Does not full reflect the final polish
-May contain bugs that have been addressed in the full version of the game

As a throwback, here's a few youtubers reviewing the Demo:
https://youtu.be/KIGjOCb49C8
special info*- the game was originally titled 'Switch' (as seen in this demo). We had to expand the name in the final version to differentiate ourselves from the console. 
:)

Thank you.

notes.title: Trading Cards!!
notes.notes:
Did someone say 'Trading Cards'

You read that right, Switch - Or Die Trying now has Trading Cards.. woohoo.

If you've played the game these should auto-populate in your steam inventory;
If not give the game a spin for a couple of minutes and earn those super yummy trading cards.
complete your collection by heading overt to the steam market pace, we've got, 

-Trading cards
-Badges
-Emoticons  
-Backgrounds 

that you can add to your collection.

Also, don't forget to unlock all the in-game achievements.

Keep switching :)
